correctness.rationale: For balanced 2m branch words center derivative M^{#β−#α}=1, so odd n have none. On a cyclic minimum cut the center maps g_k and admissible inverses cancel iff nested labels match; M^m valid label choices per binary bridge. At original cut the negative excursion minimum -j leaves j contractions and a center interval of physical length M^{-j}; strictly interior periodic base/stable coordinates are unique by expansion and contraction. Reflection principle counts B_m(j)=binom(2m,m+j)−binom(2m,m+j+1). Verify ∑B=binom(2m,m). From m B_m(j)/binom(2m,m)→2j+1, bounded by 2j+1, geometric weighting M^{-j} allows dominated convergence yielding C_M=M(M+1)/(M−1)^2; Stirling produces (4M)^m/(sqrt(pi)m^{3/2}). Telescoping reflection formula and Gaussian bridge ratio yield CDF 1−e^{-x²}; length-weighted fixed-j law follows by same dominating bound. Independently enumerated center interval constraints using exact rational arithmetic for M=2,3 and m≤3, including M=2,m=2 counts 8,12,4 for lengths 1,1/2,1/4; this finite check is corroboration, not all-period proof.
